title.hr: cron i mjerači vremena: propušteni termini
title.en: cron vs systemd timers: missed runs

concept.hr: Propušteni termini, Persistent= i nasumična odgoda
concept.en: Missed runs, Persistent= and randomized delay

summary.hr: Redak u crontabu i mjerač vremena rade isti posao dok je stroj ugašen: cron propušteno zaboravlja, a Persistent= ga nadoknađuje jednom.
summary.en: A crontab line and a timer do the same job while the machine is off: cron forgets the missed time, Persistent= makes it up once.

title.hr: Persistent=: tri propuštena termina, jedna nadoknada
title.en: Persistent=: three missed elapses, one catch-up

concept.hr: Nakon vikenda bez struje mjerač nadoknađuje jednom, a ne tri puta
concept.en: After a weekend switched off the timer catches up once, not three times

title.hr: Zamka ILI u cronu: dan u mjesecu i dan u tjednu
title.en: The cron OR trap: day of month and day of week

concept.hr: 0 3 1 * 1 znači svakog prvog i svakog ponedjeljka, ne prvog ako je ponedjeljak
concept.en: 0 3 1 * 1 means every 1st and every Monday, not the 1st if it is a Monday
